column6: @wRN{En-me-barage-si}, the king, built the @wTN{Iri-nanam} in @wDN{Enlil's} temple. @wRN{Aga}, son of @wRN{En-me-barage-si}, made the @wTN{Tummal} flourish and brought @wDN{Ninlil} into the @wTN{Tummal}. Then the @wTN{Tummal} fell into ruins for the first time.

@wRN{Meš-Ane-pada} built the @wTN{Bur-šušua} in @wDN{Enlil's} temple. @wRN{Meš-ki-aŋ-nuna}, son of @wRN{Meš-Ane-pada}, made the @wTN{Tummal} flourish and brought @wDN{Ninlil} into the @wTN{Tummal}. Then the @wTN{Tummal} fell into ruins for a second time.

@wRN{Gilgameš} built the @wTN{Numunbura} in @wDN{Enlil's} shrine. @wRN{Ur-lugal}, son of @wRN{Gilgameš}, made the @wTN{Tummal} flourish and brought @wDN{Ninlil} into the @wTN{Tummal}. Then the @wTN{Tummal} fell into ruins for a third time.

@wRN{Nanni} built the Lofty Garden in @wDN{Enlil's} temple. @wRN{Meš-ki-aŋ-@wDN{Nanna}}, son of @wRN{Nanni}, made the @wTN{Tummal} flourish and brought @wDN{Ninlil} into the @wTN{Tummal}. Then the @wTN{Tummal} fell into ruins for a fourth time.

@wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, built the @wTN{E-kur}. @wRN{Šulgi}, son of @wRN{Ur-@wDN{Namma}}, made the @wTN{Tummal} flourish and brought @wDN{Ninlil} into the @wTN{Tummal}. Then the @wTN{Tummal} fell into ruins for a fifth time.

From the years of @varh[t213.v1]{@wRN{Amar-@wDN{Suena}} } @vart[t213.v2,t213.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} @wRN{Šu-@wDN{Suen}} } until King @wRN{Ibbi-@wDN{Suen}} chose @varh[t213.v3]{@wPN{En-am-gal-ana} } @vart[t213.v4,t213.v3]{@varn{1. ms. has instead:} @wPN{En-me-gal-ana} } by extispicy as the high priest of @wDN{Inana} of @wSN{Unug}, @wDN{Ninlil} came regularly to the @wTN{Tummal}.
Written according to the words of @wPN{Lu-Inana} the chief leatherworker of @wDN{Enlil}.
@wRN{Išbi-@wDN{Erra}}, who looks after the @wTN{E-kur}, built the storehouse of @wDN{Enlil}.
